listing.name: One Must Fall 2097 / OpenOMF (omf2097)
listing.summary: Explore One Must Fall 2097 / OpenOMF (omf2097) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start the managed Windows player
steps.instruction: The official archive includes the freeware One Must Fall 2097 resources and the native OpenOMF player. Choose Play after installation; no commercial source files or generation step are needed. The package also includes an ARM64 player; this route uses openomf.exe for x86-64.

steps.title: Start the managed Linux AppImage
steps.instruction: Install the stable x86-64 AppImage in Portcove and choose Play. Your Linux system needs AppImage support. The package includes the freeware resources and its own SDL2 libraries. For a custom OpenOMF override or alternate resource set, keep a separately prepared copy.

steps.title: Prepare the upstream Apple Silicon package
steps.instruction: Extract the stable Apple Silicon ZIP into a separate folder. If it contains usr/bin/openomf, check the Homebrew library requirements below and keep the entire usr tree. Set OPENOMF_RESOURCE_PATH to the absolute path to the extracted usr/share/games/openomf folder when launching that player. If the package instead contains OpenOMF.app, keep the app intact and follow its release instructions.

warnings: Portcove manages the selected Windows and Linux runtime packages. You and upstream maintain independently prepared copies, including the Mac package. Back up the actual configuration and state folders separately. An explicit OPENOMF_CONFIG_PATH or OPENOMF_STATE_PATH can change those locations.

references.title: Check the inspected stable packages
references.instruction: The inspected 0.8.6 AppImage needs glibc 2.38 or later for its bundled libraries. The separate 0.8.6 Linux TAR.GZ needs glibc 2.43 and system libraries. The loose 0.8.6 Apple Silicon ZIP needs macOS 14 and Homebrew libepoxy, confuse, enet, sdl2_mixer, libxmp, libpng, opusfile, miniupnpc, libnatpmp and sdl2-compat. The binary loads specific library versions from /opt/homebrew. The macOS 15 app layout was observed on the separate rolling channel.

references.title: Find the effective OpenOMF profile
references.instruction: After explicit OpenOMF overrides, upstream checks XDG_CONFIG_HOME for configuration and XDG_STATE_HOME for state, then the SDL preference directory. Preserve settings, saves, scores, recordings, screenshots and user mods at their effective locations.

presentation.manual_preparation: The official packages include the freeware One Must Fall 2097 resources. Choose Play after installation. The Windows ZIP includes an ARM64 player alongside the managed x86-64 executable. The managed Linux route uses the stable x86-64 AppImage and its bundled resources. OpenOMF keeps configuration and state in its external profile, normally AppData/OpenOMF on Windows or ~/.local/share/OpenOMF on Linux. On Linux, explicit XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME select their own absolute locations, and XDG_DATA_HOME can change the SDL preference root. Back up settings, saves, scores, screenshots, recordings and user mods separately. Use a separately prepared copy for custom OpenOMF overrides or alternate resources. Package resources and bundled mods stay with their installed version.
